latestThickening.boundary: This is deterministic bounded lexical negation masking and branch-scoped structural audit logic. It does not resolve general semantic negation scope, adjudicate truth, score evidence quality, prove source independence or infer that UNSPECIFIED material is contradictory.

shrooming.boundary: Published-state inspection, sandbox reading, greenhouse question probing, and explicit formal greenhouse round advancement remain executable. In the verified active NOSTROMO loop, SHROOMING has a separate feedback-conditioned deterministic reader v0.3. Only explicit structured upstream markers can condition reading; when evidence, contradiction and question signal classes co-occur, their bounded lens priorities compose instead of one signal silently overriding the others. Ordinary lexical mentions remain auditable but cannot hijack conditioning. The formal RUN_READING_ROUND baseline remains parent-invariant v0.9 and unchanged, preserving R111→R112→R113 reproducibility. Neither the feedback-conditioned active-loop reader nor the formal/experimental branches represent semantic learning or ten independently persistent live LLM processes.

muther.boundary: Published mining-state audit and repository corpus mining are executable. MINE_REPO allows each matching repository file to contribute a bounded number of separated query windows before deduplication, preserving path, true source occurrence ordinal, occurrence offset, query-occurrence count and source-family provenance. The verified v0.2.1 adversarial test proves that if occurrence 2 is skipped by the minimum-gap guard, later selected occurrences retain ordinals 3 and 4 instead of being renumbered as selected windows 2 and 3. This reduces structural first-hit blindness without compressing source-event order. Candidates are still fingerprinted after superficial normalization, exact copies are suppressed, a conservative character-shingle lexical-overlap guard contains near duplicates with an audit ledger, and bounded selection remains round-robin across path-derived source families. This is deterministic lexical/structural coverage, not semantic clustering or vein detection, exhaustive within-file coverage, source-independence proof, source-quality scoring, novelty proof or truth judgment. Query-scoped Google Drive mining is executed by the authorized external connector runtime and handed back as redacted evidence. MINE_INTERNAL remains limited to explicit authorized query-scoped connector sources; it does not grant exhaustive private-environment crawling or cross-source enumeration. FALSIFY remains repository-scoped and absence is never upgraded to truth.

droplet.boundary: Published evidence audit and explicit-URL verification are executable. Search-engine discovery is executed by the external web connector runtime. VERIFY v1.3 computes SUPPORTED, REFUTED or INDETERMINATE over an explicit evidence bundle while suppressing exact replay amplification, counting caller-supplied source families as audit metadata, forcing INDETERMINATE on conflicting authoritative directions or contradictory use of one evidence fingerprint, and optionally enforcing a caller-supplied freshness policy. Under an active policy, stale, undated, future-dated, and coarse date ranges that overlap the as-of boundary stay visible for audit but cannot create certainty. It does not infer whether a claim is time-sensitive, search the web by itself, validate timestamps, prove source independence, score methodological quality, or treat absence of refutation as global truth.

gut.boundary: GUT v0.2.25 is a deterministic heuristic metabolic router, with active carry rendering v1.1.12. Risk quarantine is now context-gated: dedicated failure/risk paths, explicit failure status values, and explicit status/result/outcome failure markers are quarantined, while ordinary semantic prose that merely mentions error, rejected or invalid remains eligible for normal evidence/claim/contradiction routing. It preserves nutrient atoms, routes and provenance while applying bounded carry-rendering containment for inherited substrate, intra-atom and cross-segment echoes, volatile lineage, nested clauses, repeated route metadata, delimiter collisions and exact bare true/false/null/undefined scaffolding. Machine-only hexadecimal ref/targetRef/clause/clauseRef identifiers are excluded from prose carry and preserved separately in a bounded carryRefs ledger with path, route, type and provenance. Bare scalar cleanup is carry-only: numeric evidence and substantive lexical phrases are retained, and source nutrients are not mutated. These are deterministic structural/contextual routing rules, not semantic deletion, truth judgment, semantic novelty detection, semantic identity, semantic risk understanding or proof that all metabolic echo is solved.

vajra.boundary: VAJRA retains proposition-aware dismantling, uncertainty/provenance preservation, contest persistence, multi-organ conflict-context routing, replay containment, content-bound history attestation and semantic-operator-preserving replay identity. Its ambiguity guard is now v0.4.1 and branch-scoped: qualifying executed returns that share targetRef + clauseRef + lens are evaluated together even when organ labels differ, so cross-organ arrival order cannot silently create first-receipt closure when at least one relation remains lexically UNSPECIFIED. A bounded English/Chinese negation mask prevents obvious negated support/refute phrases such as does not support, does not refute and 並未支持 from being counted as positive directional evidence merely because the bare keyword appears. Same-direction cross-organ returns do not become ambiguous merely because their organ labels differ, and malformed/non-executed returns remain excluded. Its cross-organ provenance-diversity/content-replay guard remains v0.3.3, including comparison, equality, addition/subtraction, multiplication and division operator preservation. Distinct organ or canonical provenance labels still do not prove real-world source independence. These remain deterministic lexical/structural guards, not general semantic negation-scope resolution, semantic adjudication, factual truth, derivative-source detection or real-world source-independence proof.
